note: Company names came from the conference participant list supplied by the Pegasus founder. Descriptions below were verified against each company's public website before use.

lenders.name: Anchor Loans
lenders.description: Private direct lender providing business-purpose real estate financing to investors, builders and developers, including bridge, renovation, ground-up construction and rental financing.

lenders.name: Backflip
lenders.description: Real estate investment platform and lender offering financing for residential investors alongside property analysis and deal-evaluation tools.

lenders.name: Boomerang Capital Partners
lenders.description: Private real estate finance company focused on asset-backed lending for experienced investors and builders, including fix-and-flip and renovation financing.

lenders.name: Carolina Capital Management
lenders.description: Hard money lender serving real estate investors and small builders with business-purpose financing for investment properties.

lenders.name: Constructive Capital
lenders.description: Business-purpose real estate lender offering DSCR, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, line-of-credit and portfolio financing programs.

lenders.name: CV3 Financial Services
lenders.description: Private lender providing financing for non-owner-occupied investment properties, including bridge, rental, fix-and-flip and ground-up construction loans.

lenders.name: Iron Trust Capital
lenders.description: Real estate investment-property lender offering ground-up construction, fix-and-flip, DSCR rental, portfolio and bridge loan programs.

lenders.name: Kennedy Funding
lenders.description: Direct private lender specializing in commercial bridge loans for acquisitions, land, development, workouts, bankruptcies and other time-sensitive real estate situations.

lenders.name: Laker Lending
lenders.description: Direct private lender focused on short-term bridge and rehabilitation loans for residential real estate investors.

lenders.name: Lima One Capital
lenders.description: Nationwide real estate investment lender offering specialized financing for fix-and-flip, rental, multifamily and new-construction strategies.

lenders.name: Newport Capital
lenders.description: Private credit provider to middle-market commercial and residential real estate owners, operators and developers, with senior bridge, liquidity and structured capital solutions.

lenders.name: Park Place Finance
lenders.description: Nationwide private lender providing renovation, bridge, rental and ground-up construction financing for real estate investors.

lenders.name: Rain City Capital
lenders.description: Private and hard money lender serving real estate investors with fix-and-flip, DSCR rental and ground-up construction financing.

lenders.name: RCN Capital
lenders.description: Nationwide private direct lender offering fix-and-flip, DSCR rental, multifamily and ground-up construction financing for real estate investors.

lenders.name: Red Tower Capital, Inc.
lenders.description: Independent private real estate lending and investment firm specializing in bridge loans, bespoke lending solutions and alternative investments.

lenders.name: Roc Capital
lenders.description: Capital provider for private lenders and originators offering residential real estate investor loan programs including fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, bridge and rental financing.
